target.strategy: Reuse the generalized analysis engine after the Gotaleden refactor is finished; keep ÖST event-specific acquisition and normalization in this repository.

invariants: Never fabricate checkpoint passages, status, rank, route geometry or relay structure.
Keep raw source identifiers and labels alongside semantic normalization.
A race family is not a course version. Cross-year course comparison is gated by verified geometry evidence.
Trace de Trail public geometry diagnostics may establish comparability but are not automatically redistributed as route assets.
Duo inherits the same-year Ultra route/course version, but team/member result parsing is handled by a dedicated relay adapter.
Bengtemölla is the canonical named checkpoint for 2022/2023. The preceding 32 km observation remains a separate approach/prewarning candidate.
Feature availability is data-driven through data/derived/analysis-capabilities.json.

race_catalog.purpose: Display/source metadata for each race-year instance.

courses.rule: Only expose a route asset when a locally usable route source exists. Geometry-comparison evidence alone does not satisfy this requirement.

races.rule: course_version may be null while historical geometry remains unresolved; frontend features requiring route data must then be disabled.

checkpoints.rule: Keep non-primary timing observations in provenance/source data even when analysis_boundary=false.

splits.rule: Only published/observed passages are emitted. No interpolation belongs in the source split table; interpolation happens in the frontend replay model.

teams.rule: Do not emit synthetic team-member structures before Sportstiming Duo parsing is verified.

elevation.rule: Use one common smoothing/resampling method for cross-year D+/profile comparisons; raw dense barometric sums are not authoritative.

feature_gating.frontend_rule: Hide or explain unavailable features instead of rendering empty/fictional analyses.

known_current_pattern.ultra60: Finish/result analysis source-ready for all held years; advanced split analysis exists for all held years; replay/map features additionally require a usable local route asset.
known_current_pattern.duo60: Finish class exists, route inherited from Ultra; dedicated team/relay parsing is still required.
known_current_pattern.trail22_trail14_trail5: Finish/result analysis is source-ready; sampled Sportstiming result details do not currently expose intermediate split tables, so replay/split features stay off unless stronger source evidence is later found.

identity_policy.default: Do not infer stable cross-year identity from names alone without an explicit matching methodology and confidence field.
identity_policy.repeat_runner_analysis: May use a separately documented probabilistic/normalized-name linkage layer, never overwrite source identity.
